job.rawJd: Our client, an award-winning pharmaceutical advertising agency, is seeking an Account Supervisor on a contractual basis in a fully remote role. Duties include strategic, creative, and collaborative thinking; understanding the digital marketplace and ad formats; clear communication and presentations; junior-staff management; strong client relationships; day-to-day client leadership; project development; account workflow, creative-brief, and financial-management processes; assisting with SOW development and drafting descriptions, tactics, budgets, and timelines with direction; budget management and financial tracking with project management; brand-plan development; identifying gaps in marketing tactics; workshops and brainstorming; communicating strategy and tactical plans; developing actionable project briefs and project palettes; and monitoring brand and competitor news, trends, and white-space opportunities. Requirements include four to seven years of pharmaceutical advertising agency experience, strong written and verbal communication, a bachelor's degree, familiarity with pharmaceutical medical, legal, and regulatory review processes and systems, FDA rules and brand lifecycle, active client service and project execution, management of multiple projects and priorities, brand operations and PRC processes, Veeva systems, industry guidelines such as CAN-SPAM and privacy policy, brand positioning and messaging, market-research methods, key customers, competitors, and advocacy groups. Media experience is a plus.
